Is that okay, or is it wrong? Well, taking care of someone's pet is a responsibility. When my friend asked me to look after his dog, he probably trusted me to do the right thing. Not feeding the dog could mean that the dog went hungry, which isn't good. Pets rely on their owners or caregivers to provide them with food, water, and basic care. So, not feeding the dog might have been neglectful. But wait, why didn't I feel sorry? Maybe I didn't realize how important it was to feed the dog, or perhaps I thought it wasn't a big deal. But even then, I should have made an effort to ensure the dog was fed, perhaps by buying food or contacting my friend for help. I also need to consider how my friend feels about this. It's important to take care of others' pets when asked, as it's a sign of respect and trust. Maybe I should reflect on why I didn't feel sorry.
